signup.a: Create your account on the <portal>Tarteeb portal</portal>. If you get stuck, follow the <guide>5-minute sign-up guide</guide> on YouTube (in Uzbek).

kabutar.a: Kabutar is the Tarteeb Telegram bot for parents. It sends a message whenever attendance is taken. One bot serves every center.

connect.q: How do parents connect to Kabutar?
connect.a: When you register a student, their parents automatically receive an SMS to connect to Kabutar.

telegram.a: No. Alerts also go out by SMS, so parents without Telegram stay informed.

limit.q: What if I have more than 20 students?
limit.a: The free Solo Teacher plan covers up to 20 students. Pro covers up to 100, and Pro Max has no student limit.

guarantee.a: Yes. Pro Max includes a risk-free money-back guarantee.
